name: cr603_4_moonshadow_while_condition_not_rechecked
why: CR 603.4 / 603.2: Moonshadow's 'while this creature has a -1/-1 counter on it' is part of the trigger event, not an intervening if (603.4 applies only to an 'if' that immediately follows the trigger condition; the script's NoResolvingCheck$ True), so it is checked only as the trigger fires: seven fetchlands sacrificed with all seven triggers on the stack each trigger at six counters, and the last to resolve, after the other six have removed every counter, still resolves rather than being removed from the stack (Moonshadow's NoResolvingCheck$)
expect_not: intervening-if condition is no longer true
